title: API Type InventorySlotName
wikitext: Rather than use hard-coded ID's for inventory slots, each slot is mapped to a numeric ID at runtime using the API GetInventorySlotInfo function. This allows for future expansion and addition of new slots, as well as re-ordering of slots in the underlying code. Known slot ID's are as follows (and appear to be case insensitive): == Values == ; "HeadSlot" Head/helmet slot. ; "NeckSlot" Necklace slot. ; "ShoulderSlot" Shoulder slot. ; "BackSlot" Back/Cape slot. ; "ChestSlot" Chest slot. ; "ShirtSlot" Shirt slot. ; "TabardSlot" Tabard slot. ; "WristSlot" Wrist/Bracer slot. ; "HandsSlot" Hand/Gloves slot. ; "WaistSlot" Waist/Belt slot. ; "LegsSlot" Legs/Pants slot. ; "FeetSlot" Feet/Boots slot. ; "Finger0Slot" First finger/ring slot. ; "Finger1Slot" Second finger/ring slot. ; "Trinket0Slot" First trinket slot. ; "Trinket1Slot" Second trinket slot. ; "MainHandSlot" Main hand slot. ; "SecondaryHandSlot" Secondary hand/Off-hand slot. ; "RangedSlot" Ranged slot. ; "AmmoSlot" Ranged ammo slot. ; "Bag0Slot" First bag slot. ; "Bag1Slot" Second bag slot. ; "Bag2Slot" Third bag slot. ; "Bag3Slot" Fourth bag slot.
